title: RSA Agent ID Secures AI Agents and MCP Servers With Identity-Based Access Controls
content_md: RSA has launched RSA Agent ID, an identity security platform that discovers, secures, and governs AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in highly regulated environments. The company states that this offering addresses a growing “agentic identity” gap by applying workforce-style identity governance, authorization controls, and auditability to non-human AI actors.
